title: Figure 15: Trapped rainbow - waveguide with negative index core that can stop light
description: 3D rendering of a layered waveguide in which a guided electromagnetic wave (labeled "Guided electromagnetic wave") travels from an "Ordinary waveguide" section into a "Negative refractive index tapered waveguide" section, where the wave's colors separate into a rainbow along the taper. Layers are annotated with permittivity and permeability conditions (RHH and LHH), with axes x, y, z and core thickness 2a. Caption: "Figure 15. Trapped Rainbow: A Waveguide with Negative Index Core Can Stop Light."
